text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...... Not in, I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: This month's Monthly Twinkle...

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume to Watch in Next Year's 
Classic Class!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe... Admire Groove.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —...Still in Love.
choice_data_list:
Looks like the word has really spread by 
now.

Looks like the word has really spread by 
now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You were back?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Well... of course.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Make Debut, 3 and a half lengths ahead 
of 2nd place.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
After such an overwhelming victory, it's 
only natural that people would take 
notice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
And judging by how she looked after the 
finish line, she probably wasn't even 
going all out yet.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: What this means is—
choice_data_list:
You've gotten insanely stronger in just 
these few months.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(If I let my guard down for even a single 
day, I'll be overtaken in an instant. I 
have to... come up with a countermeasure!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: âI have a request.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please improve my training menu. Make it 
higher load, higher intensity.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: And as quickly as possible, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...I need strength. The kind of strength 
that proves I won't lose to anyone...!)
choice_data_list: …Okay, I'll consider it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although I began working on improvements 
based on Admire Groove's request, things 
weren't that simple. The reason beingâ

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Gwha...life?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Running that hard and not losing an ounce 
of speed... I couldn't do that even if I 
tried doing it on my head...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Admire Groove's training was already 
high-load and dense enough as it was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, partly due to her nature, there 
are things she hasn't proactively adopted 
until now. And that is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A mock race, was it?
choice_data_list:
Because I want the chance to gain 
practical race experience.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I don't believe it will 
be very effective.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reaction was pretty much as expected, 
but I didn't make this proposal without 
thinking it through, either.
choice_data_list:
The level of competition should be pretty 
high.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
... Indeed, these are all names I've seen 
before.
choice_data_list:
If our opponents are graded race regulars, 
it'll be well worth the contest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To improve her training menu, I propose an 
approach of learning from others to her, 
as she was already tackling high-load 
training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once they experience its usefulness 
firsthand, it'll give us far more 
flexibility in how we structure training 
menus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I chose graded-race regulars as her 
opponents because I thought that would 
provide lessons convincing enough for 
her."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. If that is the case... I 
will enter the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Nervous Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Umm... participants for the mock race, 
please gather over here!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Seeing you here made me wonder, 
but... ...is Álfr running?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who appeared was Air Groove, the 
famous Umamusume who conquered the Oaks 
and the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She is often seen keeping an eye on 
Admire Groove, concerned for her as she 
stubbornly pushes others away."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Groove doing a mock race is rare. Training 
with others isn't really in her nature.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... What's this? Nothing but graded 
stakes regulars.
choice_data_list:
Going up against that lineup, there's sure 
to be something to learn.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
True enough. Interacting with others often 
makes you realize what you're lacking 
yourself—whether by watching and learning, 
or by taking advice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In that sense, your thinking is correct.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
――If Alv were an ordinary Umamusume, that 
is.
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Brooding Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She's certainly got an aura about her. 
They don't call her a "child prodigy" for 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Hot-headed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
A rising star earning high praise even 
from Monthly Twinkle. A prime candidate 
for the Triple Tiara—I like it!

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You may have talent. However, that alone 
won't keep you winning.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "...I see. Thanks for the advice."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(If I stumble here, everything else is out 
of the question.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And the mock race began.

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Fufu, excuse me for leaving first.

text_block_list.name: Brooding Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Time to see what the "prodigy" can do.

text_block_list.name: Nervous Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So fast! Isn't everyone pushing way too 
hard right from the start?!
choice_data_list:
Looks like it's pulling quite a bit 
overall, huh…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah... the lead Umamusume is making her 
move.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
" 'Should we let her go?' 'How far is she 
gonna push the pace?' ...By disrupting the 
pack behind her like that, she catches her 
breath in an exquisite position and 
prepares for the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
On top of the skill to reliably lure the 
chasers into your trap, you also need the 
stamina to win without running yourself 
into the ground.
choice_data_list: They're graded race regulars for a reason.
You can tell they're graded race regulars.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Let's see how this turns 
out...

text_block_list.name: Hot-headed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That way's a dead end...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Narrowing down the easy running lane 
and forcing a choice between being trapped 
or swinging wide, huh...?)

text_block_list.name: Brooding Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Well... just give it up. That's just the 
kind of role that spot gets.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ……I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Brooding Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Where on earth did she just pass 
through...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Underhanded tactics are certainly 
effective, but... they only work... 
against opponents of equal standing at 
best.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Against an opponent of overwhelming skill— 
it won't work.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! How can this be...!? Where did she 
have that kind of kick left...!?

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The result was a late-surge victory for 
Admire Groove. A decisive win by a full 
length.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—That kind of mind game doesn't work on 
someone who knows their own running pace 
down to the millimeter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"And saving enough for her final kick, she 
judged the perfect position to make her 
sweeping move based on the gap to the 
leader, and unleashed her spurt."
choice_data_list:
So you saw right through it from the 
start, huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Even the positioning trap was broken 
through via the tiny gap when the outside 
Umamusume swung wide at the corner."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Instant decision-making, course-taking 
that doesn't cause interference, and the 
explosive power to blow past rivals... 
Everything is required.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The fact that she can already pull those 
off in an actual race means—
choice_data_list:
She's already way past the level of just 
learning tactical mind games.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... Truly frightening potential.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Never before had I proactively tried to 
teach Admire Groove in-depth tactical 
theory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet, the one who had mastered the 
tactics to overcome the veterans of graded 
stakes races was—
choice_data_list: Alv. This is just out of curiosity, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Has anyone ever taught you about racing?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
“...... I do not. If there's something I 
cannot do, I simply need to research, 
think, and try.”
choice_data_list:
Ngh...! Her form, her technique, all 
entirely self-taught...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, you'll never truly master it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I assumed someone had taught her at least 
the basics, but it seems I underestimated 
the situation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with her tendency to avoid relying on 
others, to think she achieved such 
strength entirely on her own...
choice_data_list: No...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Building her body, honing her techniques 
and tactics. Perhaps it's precisely 
because she did all that entirely on her 
own that she's able to draw strength from 
it at such a high level.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I'm heading out for the next one. Right 
now, I want to build up as much strength 
as I can.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Creating opportunities to learn from 
others and foster growth. The mock race 
was a proposal meant to demonstrate that 
usefulness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet she had long transcended such a level. 
With power she forged without relying on 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She reached this point through her 
'solitary strength'—thinking for herself, 
training on her own, and seeing her goals 
through to completion."
choice_data_list:
(――Then for now, I'll believe in that 
strength...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a path of growing stronger 
with others, which she didn't need, she 
would walk the path of proud solitude that 
made her who she was.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, that's it for me today.
choice_data_list: Ah, wait a sec! Take this!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the proposal for improving the 
training menu I asked for?
choice_data_list:
As requested, it's a high-load, 
high-density training menu

As requested, it's a high-load, 
high-density menu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She's not only increasing the intensity 
of each training session, but also the 
amount of time spent on them."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, even with her physical 
strength, it's right on the borderline of 
overwork."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I had thought you might come up with a 
more conservative proposal, though.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have no objections.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then starting tomorrow, we'll go with this 
menu.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—And so you went ahead and made that 
notoriously brutal training even harder, 
huh.”
choice_data_list:
Because right now, that's the best move 
for her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, likely so. However, her body is still 
developing. As her Trainer, don't you 
forget that either.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is just a fraction of the know-how I 
learned from my mother... Make sure you 
read it.
choice_data_list:
Is this... a physical conditioning 
theory...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Muscular strength alone won't build a body 
fit for racing. Do not neglect 
strengthening internal organs—especially 
the respiratory system.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If we build up her body properly like 
that, it should reduce the risk of 
overworking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Please... take good care of Alv.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only about four months remained until the 
Oka Sho. The days of striving to overturn 
the defeat from her dream and triumph over 
Still in Love had begun—
